$comment: Mission 1.69 §33, §34, §44 and §50. At most one class may be selected, and §39 forbids selecting one because it looks easier.
mission: 1.69 — Independent Product-Relevant Quantity Class Selection V1
why_no_artifact: §46 item 9 creates selected-quantity-class-v1.json only if a class is selected. None was.
why_nothing_was_selected: No class reached STRATEGICALLY_VIABLE. Q1 has two independently producing routes, dated artifacts and a deterministic predicate surface, and one load-bearing question about population remains open. Q7 has two independent producers and WEAK product relevance, which §33 does not admit and §22 forbids strengthening by promoting a configuration fact into a customer relationship.

the_class_that_came_closest.name: Fixed-corpus HTTP / HTML observation
the_class_that_came_closest.why: It is the first class in this arc where two apparatuses are established first-party as independently PRODUCING observations of the same kind of thing, both publish dated artifacts, both publish which items they covered, and one stores the raw response with its HTTP headers.
the_class_that_came_closest.one_load_bearing_question: Whether a population can be frozen honestly when neither apparatus can be directed at the frozen corpus, so the joint population is the corpus intersected with two independently determined coverages.
the_class_that_came_closest.what_makes_the_question_answerable: Coverage is metadata rather than a measurement value, and both apparatuses publish it. A restriction rule could in principle be frozen before any value is retrieved.
the_class_that_came_closest.why_it_was_not_selected_anyway: Because the question is open, and §35's preference for this class is a tie-break that may not push it through a failed gate.

primary_outcome_reasoning.why_not_B_fixed_corpus_selected: B would select Q1. Its population question is open, and §50 says outcome I explicitly does NOT select the class.
primary_outcome_reasoning.why_not_H_none_identified: H says no class has two credible same-proposition independent routes. Q1 HAS two credible independent routes, established first-party on both sides; what is unresolved is population alignment, not the routes. Reporting H would understate what was established and would send the next mission looking for routes it already has.
primary_outcome_reasoning.why_not_G_dns_selected: Q7 has two independent producers and WEAK product relevance, and strengthening that relevance would require the semantic promotion §22 forbids.
primary_outcome_reasoning.what_I_explicitly_does_not_mean: It does not select a class, it does not freeze a construct, and it does not establish that the population question can be answered.

recommended_next_mission.$comment: §53, the outcome-I branch: qualify only the unresolved web routes, and do not restart broad class discovery.
recommended_next_mission.recommended: Mission 1.70 — Fixed-Corpus Web Route Qualification V1
recommended_next_mission.scope: Only Q1's unresolved routes. Not a new class sweep, and not a construct freeze.
recommended_next_mission.the_question_it_must_answer_first: Whether a joint population can be frozen honestly when neither apparatus can be pointed at the corpus — that is, whether restricting to items both covered is a preregistration or a population chosen after looking.
other_questions_it_should_close: Common Crawl's URL selection and seeding
whether past datasets on both sides remain available unchanged
HTTP Archive's redirect policy and header queryability
the data licence of both, for commercial-purpose compatibility
whether an operator-run bounded fetcher is a governance-acceptable second route
